docs.title: Home
docs.text: Mera-Arch(MAY-rah or meh-rah) it translates to "MY" and is taken from the Hindi word 'mera'. Its meant to signify a customization of Arch for myself and through my vision.

docs.title: Tools included
docs.text:
• Wofi(overall search)
  • Programming: Ghostty + Tmux + neovim
  • Gaming: Steam
  • Media: Stremio and Rmpc Media for music
  • Communcation: Whatsapp and Signal

docs.title: Window Management
docs.text:
Hotkey Action

Super + w Close window

Super + ↑ Maximize window

Super + h Minimize window

Super + Backspace Resize window

Super + t Check window layout

Shift + F11 Fullscreen

docs.title: Window Navigation
docs.text:
Hotkey Action

Super + h Shift focus to window on left

Super + l Shift focus to window on right

Super + j Shift focus to window below

Super + k Shift focus to window above

docs.title: Workspaces
docs.text:
Hotkey Action

Alt + 1 Workspace 1

Alt + 2 Workspace 2

Alt + 3 Workspace 3

Alt + 4 Workspace 4

Alt + 5 Workspace 5

Alt + 6 Workspace 6

docs.title: Start Applications if no instance present and switch to workspace
docs.text:
Hotkey Action

Super + 1 ghostty Super + 2 firefox Super + 3 steam Super + 4 stremio Super + Shift + 4 rmpc(music player) Super + 5 Whatsapp Super + Shift + 5 Signal Super + 6 Launch / switch to pinned app

docs.title: Applications
docs.text:
Hotkey Action

Super + Space Wofi launcher

Shift + +Shift + Alt + 1 New Ghostty window

Shift + Shift + Alt + 2 New Firefox window

docs.title: Shift Application to workspace
docs.text:
Hotkey Action

Super + ALT + 1 Shift to Programming Workspace Super + ALT +2 Shift to Browser Workspace Super + ALT +3 Shift to Gaming Workspace Super + ALT +4 Shift to Media Workspace Super + ALT + 5 Shift to Communication Workspace Super + ALT +6 Shift to Misc Workspace

docs.title: Install Guide
docs.text:
This page covers the installation guidelines for Mera-Arch on an existing Debian 13

Command

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prithvijitguha/mera-arch/main/boot.sh | bash
